srid pa na de kho na nyid rtogs pa 'di 'dra med pas/ der yang dpe med mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' las

(254) 'das pa myong bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa 'gal ba de bzlog dka' ba ni/ der ni de ltar stong nyid ma rtogs pas dge ba sgrub pa'i stobs chung zhing der ni dge ba'i rten dal 'byor gyi tshe yang thung ba nyid yin la/ tshe gnas dus der yang gson pa dang nad med kyi thabs sogs sgrub par byed pa dang ngal ba dang gnyid dang gzhan gyis 'tshe ba dang*/ de bzhin du byis pa dang 'grog pa la sogs pa don med kyi bya ba rnams kyis tshe 'di don med du myur du 'da' zhing*/ snang ba bden med du rnam par dpyod pa shin tu rnyed par dka' bas na/ der yang dngos por zhen pa'i rnam g.yengs thog med nas goms pa de bzlog pa'i thabs ni ga la yod/ rang la mthun rkyen ma tshang bar ma zad kyi gzhan gyis 'gal rkyen byed pa yang yod de/ der yang ngan song chen por ni ltung phyir bdud ni brtson par byed cing der ni bdud kyis bstan pa log pa'i lam mang zhing*/ yang dag pa'i lam la the tshom za ba las kyang brgal bar dka' ste/ de dag gi stobs kyis slar yang dal ba rnyed dka' zhing sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed pa shin tu dka' la nyon mongs chu bo spang dka' ste/ e ma 'khor ba 'di rnams sdug bsngal brgyud mar myong bar 'gyur ro zhes brtse bas smras pa'o// gsum pa phyin ci log gi dbang gis sdug bsngal bde bar 'dzin pa ni/ de ltar shin tu sdug bsngal bar gnas kyang rang sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu la zhugs pa ma mthong ba gang (255) yin pa'i sems can sdug bsngal gyi chu bor gnas pa 'di dag kyi hud mya ngan bya bar 'os te/ dper na 'ga' zhig yang yang khrus byas shing yang yang mer 'jug pa'i stobs kyis de ltar shin tu sdug bsngal bar gnas kyang*/ de la bdag nyid bde bar rlom pa bzhin du sdug bsngal la bde bar rlom pa yin pas so// de ltar shin tu sdug bsngal yang rga ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal med pa bzhin du sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa la spyod pas gnas pa rnams la dang po nyid du 'chi bdag gis gsod par byas nas/

de nas ngan song gsum du ltung ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa 'ong bas 'di dag sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'dis bcings so// zhes dgongs so// gnyis pa la gnyis las/ bde bar smon pa ni/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi mes gdungs pa rnams la bsod nams kyi sprin las legs par byung ba'i rang gi bde ba'i tshogs kyi char gyis de dag gi sdug bsngal de zhi bar byed par nam zhig 'gyur/ gnyis pa phan pa'i rgyur smon pa ni/ nam zhig chos thams cad dmigs pa med par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis gus pas thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags te rang gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas gzhan dmigs pas sbyang bar 'gyur ba rnams la stong pa nyid ni ston par 'gyur zhig gu snyam du dgongs pas so// le'u dgu pa bshad zin to// // (256) gsum pa brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i don la gnyis te/ bsod nams bsngo ba dang*/ bka' drin dran pa'i phyag bya ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ gdul bya gzhan don dang*/ rtsom pa po rang gi don dang*/ thun mong bstan pa'i don du bsngo ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi phan bde 'grub pa'i dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams kyi bzhed don 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ spyi'i dang*/ khyad par du bstan pa la zhugs pa'i don du bsngo ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ so so'i don du dang*/ thun mong gi don du bsngo ba'o// dang po la gnyis las/ dang po phan pa'i don du bsngo ba ni/ bdag gis byang chub spyod pa la// 'jug pa rnam par brtsams pa yi// dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun// byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /ces pa'o// gnyis pa bde ba'i don du bsngo ba ni/ phyogs rnams kun na lus dang sems sdug bsngal ba'i nad pa ji snyed yod pa rnams de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyis bde dga' rgya mtsho thob par shog de dag sangs rgyas kyi bde ba ma thob kyi bar du nam yang bde ba las nyams par ma gyur cig

'gro bas byang chub sems dpa' yi// bde ba rgyun mi 'chad par shog /mdo sde'i rgyan las/ brtan pa brtse dang ldan pa'i sbyin pa yis// sbyin pa'i bde ba byed pa gang yin pa// de la khams gsum nye bar spyod rnams kyis// bde ba de yi char yang mi (257) phod do// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ngan 'gro dang*/ bde 'gro'i don du bsngo ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dmyal ba dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ yi dwags kyi don du bsngo ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sdug bsngal rang zhi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi mthus zhi bar smon pa'o// dang po la bstan bshad gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten khams na dmyal ba dag /gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams// de dag tu ni lus can rnams// bde can bde bas dga' bar shog /ces pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ chu bur can dang*/ chu bur rdol pa dang*/ a chu zer ba dang*/ so tham pa dang*/ kyi hud zer ba dang*/ utpal ltar gas pa dang*/ padma ltar gas pa dang*/ padma ltar cher gas pa ste/ grang bas nyam thag pa'i dmyal ba brgyad po de dag gis dro ba thob par shog byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gnyis kyi sprin chen las byung ba'i chu bo mtha' yas kyis/ yang sos dang*/ thig nag dang*/ bsdus 'joms dang*/ ngu 'bod dang*/ ngu 'bod chen po dang*/ tsha ba dang*/ rab tu tsha ba dang*/ mnar med pa ste tsha bas nyam thag pa'i dmyal ba brgyad po de dag bsil bar shog ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal yang*// de la dga' tshal sdug gur shog /shal ma li yi sdong po dag /dpag bsam shing du 'khrungs (258) par shog /mthing ril ngur pa dag dang ngang pa dang*// bzhad sogs skad snyan 'byin pas mdzes gyur cig /padma dri bsung che ldan mtsho dag gis// dmyal ba'i sa phyogs dag ni nyams dgar shog /sol phung de yang rin chen phung por gyur// lcags sreg gi sa gzhi shel gyi sa gzhi bstar bar shog bsdus 'joms ri bo rnams kyang mchod pa yi// gzhal med khang du gyur te de dag bde gshegs rnams kyis gang bar shog

mdag ma me dang rdo sreg pa dang mtshon gyi char pa dag deng nas bzung ste me tog char par gyur/ phan tshun gcig la gcig mtshon gyis brdeg pa de yang ni deng nas rtsed mo rtse ba'i phyir me tog 'phen par shog chu bo rab med me dang 'dra ba'i nang du bying ba dag sha kun 'tshigs nas zhig bar gyur te rus gong me tog kunda'i mdog ltar dkar por gyur pa rnams/ bdag gi dge ba'i stobs kyis lha yi lus thob nas// lha mo rnams dang lhan cig dal gyis 'bab par gnas par shog /gnyis pa ni/ ci'i phyir 'dir ni gshin rje'i mi dang khwa dang bya rgod mi bzad rnams skrag byed// kun nas mun bsal bde ba dang dga' ba bskyed pa'i mthu bzang 'di ko su yi mthu snyam ste// gyen du bltas pas nam mkha'i dkyil na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje gzi brjid 'bar ba bzhugs pa mthong nas rab tu dga' zhing dang ba'i shugs kyis sdig dang bral nas phyag na rdo rje de dang lhan cig 'grog par (259) shog me tog char pa spos chu dang 'dres pa bab pa yis dmyal ba'i me mdag chil chil gsod pa mthong gyur nas/ glo bur bde bas tshim pa 'di ci las gyur bsam pa dang sems dmyal rnams kyis de ltar mdzad pa po phyag na padma bsnams pa spyan ras gzigs mthong bar shog 'ga' zhig gis 'jam dbyangs mthong nas gzhan rnams la grogs dag ces bos te/ 'jigs pa bor la rings par tshur shog 'u bu'i thad du ni gang gi mthu yis sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing dga' ba'i shugs phyin la 'gro ba kun skyob ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sel nus kyi 'od zer dang sil bar byed pa'i brtse ba skyes par gyur pa gzhon nu zur phud can 'bar ba 'jam dbyangs kyis 'jigs pa med par byed pas na gzhan du bros te ci zhig phyin te phyin mi dgos kyi grogs po khyed rnams kyis/ lha brgya'i cod pan dag gis zhabs kyis padma la mchod cing*/

thugs rjes brlan pa'i spyan dang ldan pa'i dbu la me tog du ma'i tshogs kyi char 'bab pa'i 'jam dbyangs khang pa brtsegs pa yid du 'ong ba lha mo stong phrag bstod dbyangs sgrogs pa'i nang na bzhugs pa 'di ltos zhes grogs rnams la de bstan te/ thams cad kyis 'jam dbyangs de 'dra mthong nas da ni sems dmyal dga' bas ku co 'don par shog de ltar bdag gi dge rtsas kun tu bzang po la sogs pa ste byams pa dang sa'i snying po dang nam (260) mkha'i snying po dang byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med pa ste sgrib pa rnam sel la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu las byung ba'i sprin bde ba ste yid du 'ong ba dang bsil zhing dri zhim ngad ldan char pa 'bebs mthong nas/ sems can dmyal ba de dag mngon par dga' gyur cig /gnyis pa ni/ dud 'gro rnams ni gcig la gcig za ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral bar gyur cig gsum pa ni/ sgra mi snyan pa'i mi bzhin du// zas skom mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal med par/ yi dwags rnams ni bde bar gyur// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas shing*// khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /gnyis pa ni/ long ba rnams kyis gzugs mthong zhing*// 'on pas rtag tu sgra thos shog /lha mo sgyu 'phrul ji bzhin du// sbrum ma'ang gnod med btsa' bar shog /gcer bu rnams kyis gos dag dang*// bkres pa rnams kyis zas dag dang*// skom pa rnams kyis chu dag dang*// btung ba zhim po thob par shog /bkren pa rnams kyis nor thob shog /mya ngan nyam thag dga' thob shog /yi chad rnams kyang yid sos shing*// sdug bsngal dang yid mi bdes mi brdzi ba'i brtan pa phun sum tshogs par shog sems can nad pa ji snyed pa// myur du nad las thar par gyur// 'gro ba'i nad rnams ma lus (261) pa// rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog

/skrag pa rnams ni 'jigs med shog /bcings pa rnams kyang grol bar gyur// mthu med rnams ni mthu ldan zhing*// phan tshun sems ni mnyen pa ste phan sems dang ldan par gyur cig 'gron po dag ni thams cad la// phyogs rnams thams cad bde bar shog /gang gi don du 'gro byed pa// de 'bad mi dgos par 'grub par shog gru dang gru chen zhugs pa dag /yid la bsams pa 'grub gyur te// chu yi ngogs su bder phyin nas// gnyen dang lhan cig dga' bar shog /mya ngan lam gol 'khyams pa dag /mgron po dag dang phrad gyur te// chom rkun stag sogs 'jigs med par// mi ngal bde blag 'dong bar shog /'brog dgon la sogs pa lam med cing nyam nga bar/ byis pa dang rgan po mgon med pa gnyid log myos shing rab myos rnams lha dag gis srung bar byed par shog mi dal ba brgyad po kun las thar pa dang dad dang shes rab brtser ldan zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i zas dang spyod pa phun sum tshogs nas rtag tu tshe rabs dran gyur cig 'jig rten nam sems can thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du longs spyod chad pa med par shog de dag la phan tshun rtsod pa med cing 'tshe ba med par rang dbang du ni spyod par shog sems can gzi brjid chung ngu gang*// de dag gzi brjid chen por shog /dka' thub can (262) gang gzugs ngan pa// gzugs bzang phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'jig rten bud med ji snyed pa// de dag skyes pa nyid gyur cig /ma rabs rnams ni mtho thob cing*// nga rgyal dag kyang bcom par shog /gsum pa la gnyis te/ phan pa dang*/ bde ba'i rgyur bsngo ba'o// dang po ni/ bdag gis bsod nams de yis ni// sems can thams cad ma lus pa// sdig pa thams cad spangs nas ni// rtag tu dge ba byed par shog /ces spyir phan pa tsam dang*/ khyad par du bsam pa byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*/ sbyor ba byang chub spyod pa la gzhol bar shog

mthun rkyen sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*/ 'gal rkyen bdud kyi las rnams spang bar shog /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po 'dod pa 'grub par bsngo ba ni/ sems can de dag thams cad ni// tshe yang dpag med ring bar shog /rtag tu bde bar 'tsho 'gyur zhing*// 'chi ba'i sgra yang grags ma gyur// dpag bsam shing gi skyed mos tshal// sangs rgyas dang ni sangs rgyas sras// chos snyan sgrogs pas gang ba yis// phyogs rnams thams cad gang bar shog /thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*// lam mthil ltar mnyam bai ḍūrya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod dgur te thams cad du yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' mang (263) po dag rang rang gi legs pa ste rdzu 'phrul la sogs pas sa steng dag brgyan par mdzad pas bzhugs gyur cig lus can kun gyis bya dang ni// shing dang 'od zer la sogs pa thams cad dang*/ nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra// rgyun mi 'chad par thos par shog /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas dang*// sangs rgyas sras dang phrad gyur cig /phrad nas kyang mchod pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas 'gro ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas mchod par shog lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*// lo tog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed gyur cig /'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang*// nad gdon dang sdig pa la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod byas pa'i dgos pa rnams ji ltar gsungs pa ltar 'grub par shog mkha' 'gro dang srin po la sogs pa gdug pa can thams cad kyang snying rje'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig gnyis pa mi 'dod pa dang 'bral bar smon pa ni/ sems can 'ga' yang sdug ma gyur// 'jigs dang gzhan gyis brnyas par mi 'gyur zhing*// 'ga' yang yid mi bde ma gyur// gnyis pa bstan pa la zhugs pa'i don du bsngo ba la gnyis las/

dang po spyir bsngo ba ni/ gtsug lag ni chos yin la de yod pa'i khang pa'am/ dge 'dun gyi khang pa ste de rnams su dge 'dun rnams klog pa dang kha ton la sogs (264) pa chos spyod kyi bya ba rgyas shing legs par gnas par shog rtag tu dge 'dun rnams mthun pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi don yang ji ltar dgongs pa ltar 'grub par shog gnyis pa so so'i don du bsngo ba ni/ thar pa'i lam la bslab par 'dod pa'i dge slong dag dben pa dag kyang thob par shog der yang g.yeng ba thams cad spangs nas ni sems ni las su rung ba ste/ dge ba la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar du rung bas dge ba sgom par gyur cig dge slong ma rnams rnyed ldan zhing phan tshun 'thab pa dang gzhan gyis gnod pa spang bar shog de bzhin du rab tu byung ba kun tshul khrims nyams pa med par gyur cig gal te tshul khris 'chal na des yid byung ste 'gyod nas rtag tu sdig pa zad byed shog zad pa'i stobs kyis phyi mar bde 'gro dag kyang thob gyur nas/ der yang brtul zhugs mi nyams shog /mkhas pa rnams ni bkur ba dang*// bsod snyoms dag kyang rnyed par shog /rgyud ni nga rgyal la sogs pas yongs su dag pa dang*/ phyogs rnams kun tu grags par shog /sems can de dag thams cad ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi myong zhing sgo gsum gyi dka' ba spyod pa med par yang gnas skabs su lha bas lhag pa'i lus kyis ni de dag mthar thug sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog sems can kun gyis lan mang du// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing*// sangs rgyas

(265) bde ba bsam yas kyis// rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni 'gro don ji ltar thugs la dgongs pa ltar 'grub par shog mgon po sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs pa ltar sems can rnams la'ang de 'byor shog de bzhin rang sangs rgyas rnams dang nyan thos rnams kyang myang 'das kyi bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig gnyis pa ni/ bdag kyang 'jam dbyangs bka' drin gyis// sa rab tu dga' 'thob bar du// rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang*// rab tu byung ba thob par shog /'di ni gdul bya rnams 'di ltar smon lam gdab pa'i phyir du gsungs kyi/ 'dis slob dpon so skye yin par mi 'grub ste/ dper na sdig pa med pas sdig bshags gsungs pa bzhin no// 'grel pa dag las kyang 'phags pa zhi ba lha zhes gsungs pa dang mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yin no// zhes 'byung ngo*// bdag ni kha zas gyi na ste ngan ngon tsam gyis kyang lus nyams dang ldan zhing 'tsho bar shog tshe rabs kun tu dben gnas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa thob gyur cig gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am// cung zad dri bar 'dod na yang*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni// gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can kun don sgrub pa'i phyir// ji ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa// bdag gi (266) spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa dang*// 'gro ba ji srid gnas gyur pa// de srid bdag ni gnas gyur nas// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci'ang rung*// de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi stobs kyis 'gro ba thams cad bde ba la spyod par shog gsum pa ni/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyi nad sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang bcas te yun ring du gnas par gyur cig gnyis pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bdag la bstan bcos 'di byed pa'i dge blo 'byung ba'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis bdag gi dge ba'i phyogs dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba'o// le'u bcu pa bshad zin to// //dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad gshegs pa'i lam// rgyal sras spyod pa pha rol phyin pa drug /legs ston gzhung 'di bshad pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /ngan song rnams ni mi bzad sdug bsngal las// rnam par grol (267) zhing thar pa'i lam rnyed nas// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal ldan pa'i// mya ngan 'das pa'i grong du myur 'jug shog /bde 'gro bde ba'i dpal las mi nyams shing*// 'khor ba'i bde ba snying po med rtogs nas// gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i spros pa rab zhi ba'i// zag med bde ba'i dpal la spyod par shog /gang gi stobs kyis sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi /mun pa kun sel phan bde padma'i tshal// rnam par rgyas byed thub bstan 'od brgya can// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas gyur cig /bslab gsum yon tan rin chen mdzod 'dzin cing*// mkhyen brtse thabs mkhas phun sum tshogs pa yis// bde gshegs bstan dang 'gro kun legs skyong ba'i// bshes gnyen mchog rnams sku tshe brtan gyur cig /bde gshegs bstan la rab zhugs skyes bu rnams// snyom las 'du 'dzi'i 'ching ba las grol te// tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i sbyor ba yis// rtag tu sgo gsum don yod spyod par shog /mkha' las dus su lha yis char 'bebs shing*// sa chen 'bru sran rtsi shing bzang pos brgyan// skye bo rab bde phan tshun byams ldan zhing*// rtag tu dge ba bcu la spyod par shog

/bdag kyang deng nas byang chub ma thob bar// 'khor ba'i bde la nam yang mi chags shing*// rang nyid thar pa'ang don du mi gnyer bar// 'gro ba'i don la rtag tu brtson par shog /gang dag (268) bdag la chags dang sdang ba dang*// bstod dang smad dang phan dang gnod byed kyang*// gang gis bdag mthong thos dang dran pa dang*// thams cad myur du byang chub mchog thob shog /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ lung rigs smra ba thog med kyis dpal e'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// //na mo buddha bo dhi satwā ya/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ji snyed zhing gi khyon// thub dbang nyi ma 'bar ba'i snang bas khyab// 'khor gyi dbus su mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgras// dus gsum kun tu dam chos sgo 'phar dbye/ 1 /zab zhi mtha' brgyad spros bral me long du// rten cing 'brel 'byung 'chad pa'i ngang tshul las// shes dang shes bya tha dad ma dmigs pa'i// shes rab 'khor lo'i 'phrul chen ci yang g.yo/ 2 /ngo mtshar rnam thar bla bre gsar pa yis// srid zhi mtha' dag khebs pa'i rmad byung dang*// lhan cig blo gros mi zad zhi ba lha// grags snyan rgyal sras bye ba'i dbus na mtho/ 3 /mgon des sde snod mdzod khang brtol ba'i dbyig /'chos skyob gnyis ldan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul zab mo la// 'jug tshul theg chen gzhung lam chog 'di (269) byung*/ 4 /'phags bod mkhas dbang du mas 'chad nyan sgor// 'grel gzhung rin chen thang mar brdal ba las// nyung ngu'i tshig gis rgya che'i don gsal ba// byang sems thogs med zhabs kyis rtsal 'di yin/ 5 /nyi ma zla ba ltar grags gzhung bzang 'dir// rnam mkhyen 'jug ngogs tshang la ma nor ba// smon 'jug byang sems kyis drangs phar phyin drug /spyod pa yongs bsngo bcas pa'i don du 'dus/ 6 /de phyir mchog gi zhal lung nyi zer gyis// bran pa'i sa skyong padma 'dab yangs ma// chos dbyings bzang mo'i thugs bskyed ri dbang ltar// mngon mtho'i dpal gyis chos sbyin phyi mor bskrun/

7 /gcig las du mar 'char ba'i ngo mtshar can// bstan 'gro spyi la sman pa'i btsas gcig pu// sde dge mi yi tshangs dbang rim byon gyi// phyag srol slar yang mi nub dar bar mdzad/ 8 /rnam dkar bdag po'i rkyen las byung ba dang*// rang gzhan 'gro ba'i dge rtsa gang mchis rnams// byang chub chen por 'bab pa'i yongs bsngo mchog /sras bcas rgyal ba'i ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig 9 /ces pa'i spar byang smon tshig dang bcas pa 'di ni/ sa skyong mi'i dbang mo mchog gi bka' stsal ltar/ rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs chos kyi nyi ma blo gros rgyas pa'i sdes smras pa sarba dā ka lya na bha wa tu// // 1$0000220༈ /bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las gu rus spel/// /1$0000270
